events.title: Global and Indian steel prices at multi-year highs (global HRC +60% y/y)
events.description: Global HRC futures are +60% y/y, +26% in 6m and +20.6% since 1 Jun 2026 (factor_state). Indian domestic HRC hit a four-year high in Sep-Oct 2026 and rebar extended its rally by late Oct (flat-long spread turned negative). Reported drivers: higher coking-coal costs (Aug), demand recovery (India finished-steel demand +7.5% in H1 FY27, worldsteel sees India +7.9% in 2026), tighter supply after EU quota/CBAM regime diverted flows, Indian safeguard duty in force, and Chinese output discipline. I could not fetch article bodies, so the relative weight of each cause is NOT verified (headline-level evidence only). Counter-currents: Reuters (6 Oct) says the steel ministry is unlikely to seek new import curbs; Awaz (19 Oct) quotes limited upside; iron ore is falling (cost relief) while coking coal is firm.
events.what_already_moved: Global HRC +20.6% since 2026-06-01, +6.2% in last month, +60.4% y/y (factor_state 2026-11-05). Indian prices: 4-year high reported 22 Sep 2026 (The Hindu/ET); experts saw another Rs 2,000/t (29 Sep). Exact Indian HRC Rs/t level not verified.

events.title: EU quota-halving steel regime and CBAM cut Indian steel exports to EU
events.description: EU CBAM definitive period began 1 Jan 2026 (certificate purchases from 2027, model knowledge); the EU's new steel import regime (replacing the safeguard; smaller quotas, higher out-of-quota tariff, melt-and-pour rules) applies from mid-2026 (LSE 6 Oct; Reuters/Outlook Business 21 Jul: Indian exports to Europe set to fall ~40%). India's H1 FY27 steel exports to the EU fell ~20% y/y while Americas +262% and Africa +96% (Moneycontrol 2 Nov; SMM 3 Nov). Studies (GMK 18 Aug; S&P/Sandbag 10 Aug) say CBAM cost may be smaller than feared. Net effect: exporters redirect volume to domestic market or other regions, which tempers Indian price gains and raises domestic competition; Tata Steel Europe, conversely, benefits from reduced imports (but Tata warns of falling EU demand, 25 Aug).

events.description: Gold peaked at ~$5,419/oz in Jan 2026 and is ~$4,128 (-8.4% since 1 Jun, -12.4% in 6m); silver is $52.5 (-30% since 1 Jun, -34% in 6m, -53% from the Jan peak; Indian silver below Rs 2 lakh/kg since 23-24 Oct, 11-month low).
